incidents.source_text: On 18 October, in North Darfur, the RSF conducted artillery shelling on a market in El Fasher city, El Fasher locality. This resulted in four fatalities and nine injuries among civilians.
incidents.title: RSF shelling of El Fasher city market
incidents.description: On 18 October, the RSF shelled a market in El Fasher city, El Fasher locality, North Darfur, killing four civilians and injuring nine.

incidents.source_text: Similarly, on 19 October in Tawila, North Darfur, an unknown actor conducted a drone strike near an IDP gathering point, resulting in an unspecified number of civilian casualties.
incidents.title: Drone strike near IDP gathering point in Tawila
incidents.description: On 19 October, an unidentified actor carried out a drone strike near an IDP gathering point in Tawila, North Darfur, causing an unspecified number of civilian casualties.

incidents.source_text: Meanwhile, in South Darfur, on 19 October, SAF's drone strike hit a fuel depot in Nyala town, Nyala locality, damaging two trucks. No casualties were reported.
incidents.title: SAF drone strike on fuel depot in Nyala
incidents.description: On 19 October, an SAF drone strike hit a fuel depot in Nyala town, Nyala locality, South Darfur, damaging two trucks. No casualties were reported.
